name: dense-control-15node
description: DENSE CONTROL for the MoE crash investigation. Matches the R-Full production run on every axis we can hold constant -- 15 nodes x 8 GPUs, 48 layers, hidden 2048, 32 Q heads / 4 KV groups, head_dim 128, seq 4096, padded vocab 151936, GBS 960, bf16, distributed optimizer, overlap grad-reduce/param-gather, unfused attention, and the SAME real 487-shard corpus blend. The ONLY difference is that every layer is dense (no experts, no router, no all-to-all, no expert parallelism). If this run also SIGSEGVs, the fault is in the shared stack (ROCm / torch nightly / TE / hardware) and not in our MoE code; if it runs clean for far longer than the MoE MTBF, the fault is MoE-specific.
